payload.reason: The evidence provides specific criteria for selecting the top 10 nonsynonymous mutations based on their frequency and biological impact on SARS-CoV-2 proteins.

claims.text: The top 10 nonsynonymous mutations were selected based on their high frequency and potential biological impact on protein function.
The selection criteria included the analysis of co-mutation ratios and the prediction of protein stability and function.
The mutations were identified from a dataset of 30,229 SARS-CoV-2 genome sequences.
